visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A glass of layered iced coffee with a white straw sits on a light-colored wooden table. In the background, the blurred interior of a modern cafe shows a wooden counter and warm ceiling lighting. (2) A large, meticulously pruned bonsai tree sits on a copper-topped stone pedestal in the center of a spacious cafe. The floor is tiled in dark grey, and wooden seating benches line the wall. (3) The camera pans to the storefront from outside, showing white noren curtains with circular bonsai logos hanging over a glass entrance. (4) Inside, the camera looks past the central bonsai towards a long service counter. A staff member in a mask and a customer are briefly visible in a medium-long shot. (5) Close-up of a wooden framed menu and a gold coin-like decoration on a shelf. (6) A glass of matcha latte with a green and white gradient is placed next to a fish-shaped taiyaki pastry on a small metal stand. (7) A hand with a silver ring stirs the matcha drink with a straw, blending the green and white layers. (8) Hands pull a taiyaki pastry apart, revealing a thick green matcha and white cream filling inside the crispy golden shell. (9) A close-up of a shelf displaying various bags of coffee beans and colorful insulated tumblers. (10) The final shot shows the cafe interior from the doorway, focusing on the central bonsai tree and the warm, minimalist design.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 日本失心瘋. [Subtitle]: 終於喝到盆栽咖啡了. (2) [Slogan]: 超熱門的銀座盆栽咖啡 每天都大排長龍. (3) [Slogan]: 最近發現開了 日本橋2號店 趕快來探店一下. (4) [Slogan]: 這間店鋪比銀座店大很多 店內座位也多了不少. (5) [Slogan]: 因為靠近辦公區 所以觀光客不太多. (6) [Slogan]: 菜單的設計... 心得寫在文字中. (7) [Slogan]: 延續銀座店的日式美學風格 營造出靜謐的氛圍. (8) [Slogan]: 聽說很多人都愛 他們的抹茶拿鐵 所以朋友點了一杯. (9) [Slogan]: 整體是偏甜的口感 抹茶的苦澀不太重 喜歡喝甜的應該會愛這杯. (10) [Slogan]: 加點了一個 抹茶餡Creamcheese 鯛魚燒最中. (11) [Slogan]: 店內現點現做的 外層還很酥脆 內餡填得滿滿滿. (12) [Slogan]: 抹茶餡的甜 加上Creamcheese的鹹 中和的滿剛好的. (13) [Slogan]: 我選了經典的盆栽拿鐵 來試試看掛上招牌名稱的定番 這杯的苦味稍重，奶味反而不明顯唷. (14) [Slogan]: 店內販售多款精品咖啡豆 我買了其中一包，很好喝. (15) [Slogan]: 推薦大家 下次可以去日本橋店唷.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A cheerful, mid-tempo jazzy-pop BGM starts immediately, featuring a clean acoustic piano melody accompanied by a standard drum kit and a warm electric bass line. There is a slight indoor room tone but no speech or crowd noise. (2) A sharp, high-frequency 'ding' SFX marks a visual transition. The BGM continues steadily. (3) A subtle percussive metallic clicking sound occurs, suggesting a spoon or straw hitting the glass as a drink is stirred. (4) A dry, mid-frequency crunching sound is heard, layered over the music, corresponding to a pastry being pulled apart. (5) Another metallic stirring sound repeats briefly. The piano-driven BGM maintains its upbeat tempo and consistent major key until the very end, ending on a clean fade.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Location Introduction -> Interior Detail -> Menu/Products -> Food Tasting -> Store Merch -> Recommendation/CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional lifestyle vlog designed to introduce a new location of the popular 'Bongen Coffee' in Nihonbashi, Tokyo. It combines aesthetic interior shots with close-up food and beverage demonstrations to attract cafe-goers and coffee enthusiasts.
